# Material from Omarchy, Omawrite and Hype

RayoMD GUI follows the look of Omarchy's own apps. What it takes from their sources, all under
the MIT notices in [`LICENSE`](LICENSE):

| What | Where it is used | Source |
|---|---|---|
| The palettes of the 23 built-in themes (`themes/<name>/colors.toml`), their `shell.toml` where a theme has one, the `rounding` of their `hyprland.lua` and whether they have a `light.mode` file | `src/ui/omarchy_themes.inc`, generated by `scripts/import_omarchy_themes.py` | [omacom/omarchy](https://github.com/omacom/omarchy) at `246f33a2fef66411c990860d88e0823ae83987fc` |
| The shell's token defaults (`default/themed/shell.toml.tpl`): control fills, borders and alphas, spacing, font sizes, popup, tooltip and menu colours | `src/ui/tokens.cpp` | omacom/omarchy at `246f33a2fef66411c990860d88e0823ae83987fc` |
| The rules that resolve a theme's colours and mode (`bin/omarchy-theme-color`: `mix_color`, `resolve_theme_mode`, `parse_colors_file`, `resolve_theme_colors`), ported to C++ | `src/ui/theme.cpp`; `tests/data/themes/*.expect` are that script's output | omacom/omarchy at `246f33a2fef66411c990860d88e0823ae83987fc` |
| The open and save icon paths (`src/FooterIconButton.qml`) | `src/ui/icons.cpp` | [omacom/omawrite](https://github.com/omacom/omawrite) at `a7da0b14e501d6aab5b67258564052727ae1d1d9` |
| The export, options, chevron-down and check icon paths (`src/AppIcon.qml`) | `src/ui/icons.cpp` | [omacom/hype](https://github.com/omacom/hype) at `d5f1a3ce6a6c924e4e07e3390c7b28b7120da59d` |
| The derived colours: muted text, accent hover (`src/apptheme.cpp:49-70`) | `src/ui/tokens.cpp` | omacom/hype at `d5f1a3ce6a6c924e4e07e3390c7b28b7120da59d` |
